description: This source file implements debugging and logging APIs for the RDK platform, including functions for dumping logs, initializing debug support, and sending debug messages.

methods.name: TouchFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a file with the given filename to serve as a log indicator.

methods.name: rdk_dbgDumpLog
methods.description: Dumps current logging settings and creates a temporary file.

methods.name: rdk_dbgInit
methods.description: Initializes the debug support system, ensuring it runs only once per boot cycle.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_MsgRaw
methods.description: Sends a formatted debug message to the debug output, with variable arguments.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_MsgRaw1
methods.description: Sends a debug message with a va_list argument, used internally.
